description: Spec §Space/set explicitly defines named mutation keys (addRoles, removeRoles, addMembers, removeMembers, updateMembers, addChannels, removeChannels, updateChannels, addCategories, removeCategories, updateCategories) and notes 'This departure from standard RFC 8620 PatchObject model is intentional.' Current impl passes arbitrary JSON Pointer patches to the backend, bypassing all permission and hierarchy checks.
title: Fix Space/set: use named semantic mutations not JSON Pointer
